displayAddress: Penthouse, Boiler House, Circus Road South, London, SW11
description:
Stunning Duplex Apartment in the Iconic Battersea Power Station ? 3 Bedrooms, 4 Bathrooms, 2 Parking Spaces

Step into luxury living at The Boiler House, Battersea Power Station ? one of London?s most prestigious addresses. This exceptional three double bedroom, four bathroom duplex spans the 11th and 12th floors (with lift access) and offers spectacular design, world-class amenities, and unbeatable connectivity.

The lower level features a beautifully designed open-plan kitchen with a breakfast bar, generous dining area, and a stylish lounge ? perfect for both entertaining and everyday living. From here, step out onto your private terrace and enjoy views over the stunning roof gardens.

A feature staircase leads to the upper level, where a second reception room with mezzanine overlooks the gardens, creating a bright and airy social space. Three double bedrooms are thoughtfully positioned off this room, each with floor-to-ceiling windows flooding the interiors with natural light.

The principal suite boasts a dressing area and a luxurious en suite bathroom, while the two further bedrooms offer fitted wardrobes and elegant en suite shower rooms with high-spec fixtures.

Residents enjoy:

    Two secure underground parking spaces

    24/7 concierge service

    Exclusive access to roof gardens, residential lounges, kitchen/bar, workspaces, Spring gym and spa

    Private lift access

Location & Lifestyle
Situated on the south bank of the River Thames, Battersea Power Station is an exciting destination in itself ? home to luxury shops, top restaurants, and green open spaces. Transport links are exceptional, with Battersea Power Station and Nine Elms Underground stations on your doorstep, plus Vauxhall nearby for Overground, Underground, and National Rail connections. A riverboat pier offers services to the City and Greenwich, while a complimentary residents? shuttle runs to Sloane Square and Vauxhall.

Deposit - 6 weeks
Term - 12 months
Council Tax - G
